abstract: The CT findings in cystic teratomas of the ovary are reviewed and our findings in four patients discussed. We analyzed those teratomas with standard CT, augmented by direct nonreconstructed coronal and sagittal views, to establish the true extent of the process and to define the characteristic heterogeneous contents. Computed tomography was successful in predicting or excluding malignant degeneration.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫のCT所見を検討し、4例の症例を考察する。標準CTに直接の非再構成冠状断像および矢状断像を加え、病変の真の進展範囲と特徴的な不均一な内容物を明らかにした。CTは悪性転化の予測または除外に成功した。
